column1: # National business counts read by hand (2026-11-10) for countries no machine-readable source covers.
# isic: "*" for the whole economy, else the ISIC Rev. 4 divisions a row covers ("05-09 35"), split
# by the country's employment in them. enterprises: all units of the row (legal and natural
# persons); sole_proprietors: those of them that are natural persons (self-employed units,
# individual entrepreneurs, MEI). employment: persons employed. micro_share: units under 10
# persons. Empty: not published. Units are counted as the source counts them (enterprises,
# establishments or registrations, see note); the share of a row is used, and the "*" total sets
# the country's weight when it draws by enterprises.
